data.task_title: Load and Analyze Pipeline Execution Data

features.title: Bottleneck Identification
features.description: Identify bottlenecks in the pipeline based on execution metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Bottlenecks are identified using statistical analysis

features.title: Data Ingestion
features.description: Develop a module to load pipeline execution data into the analysis system.
acceptance_criteria: Data can be ingested from multiple sources
Data is validated for accuracy and completeness
Ingestion process is logged for auditing

features.title: Visualization Dashboard
features.description: Create a dashboard to visualize pipeline performance metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard displays stage completion times and success rates
Users can filter data by time range and stage

features.title: Statistical Summary Generation
features.description: Generate statistical summaries of pipeline execution data.
acceptance_criteria: Summaries include key metrics like mean, median, and standard deviation
Summaries are exportable in common formats (e.g., PDF, CSV)
Summaries are updated in real-time with new data

features.title: Success Rate Calculation
features.description: Calculate and display the success rates of pipeline stages.
acceptance_criteria: Success rates are calculated for each stage
Rates are displayed in a user-friendly format
Historical success rate trends are available

features.title: Stage Completion Time Analysis
features.description: Analyze and report on the completion times of different stages in the pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: Completion times are calculated for each stage
Reports are generated with average and median times
